description: The suite's telemetry conventions (superwitness C1 and C2): the spans and log lines a run leaves, the keys SuperWitness joins them by (`run.id` above all, `attempt.id` for attempts), and how the trace crosses into a harness. Content never becomes an attribute: ids, sequence numbers and allow-listed enums only. Telemetry is best-effort: a producer never fails or repeats work because of it.

run.id.description: The SuperPipeline run the telemetry is about (`run_…`, the run join key). The key SuperWitness finds a run's spans and log lines by.

board.id.description: The SuperPipeline board the run belongs to (`brd_…`).

card.id.description: The SuperPipeline card the run works.

station.id.description: The AgentPod station that runs the harness.

attempt.id.description: One AgentPod ACP run of a harness for the dispatch (`attempt_…`). SuperWitness counts a run's spans per attempt by it.

acp.session_id.description: The AgentPod ACP session the attempt ran in (`acps_…`). With `acp.seq_from` and `acp.seq_to`, it reaches the words in `acp_events`, which never become attributes.

acp.seq_from.description: The first ACP event sequence number the span covers.

acp.seq_to.description: The last ACP event sequence number the span covers.

run.epoch.description: The claim generation of the run the dispatch observes (its lease epoch).

external.source.description: Which work source the dispatch came from (`superpipeline`).

fingerprint.digest.description: The digest of the harness's declared configuration for the attempt (`sha256:…`).

dispatch.status.description: What the dispatch returned (`reported`, `self-reported`, `unreported`, `replayed`, `failed`, `foreign-run`, …, or `threw`). Open: a reader tolerates a value it does not know.

error.type.description: A turn's error kind (AgentPod's `TurnErrorKind`), set with an error status.

run.action.description: The run verb a SuperPipeline run route serves (`heartbeat`, `complete`, …), when it has one.

dispatch.description: The root span of one claimed run, a new trace per run: from the claim to the dispatch's return.

attempt.description: One attempt of a harness at the run, a child of `dispatch`.

turn.description: One prompt and the agent's answer to it, a child of `attempt`.

run_route.description: One request to a SuperPipeline run route (`/v1/boards/:id/runs/:runId[/:action]`), when the Workers runtime traces it.

run route.description: The structured log line SuperPipeline writes once per run-route request, whether or not the request was traced; it also carries the incoming `traceparent` when one is well formed.

acp-meta-traceparent.description: The trace travels into a harness in the `_meta` of ACP `session/new` and `session/prompt` params: the hub writes the active trace's W3C context there, node-agent records a forward span as its child and rewrites `traceparent` to its own span, and the harness continues it. A hub can turn it off for a harness that refuses unknown `_meta` keys (`AGENTPOD_ACP_TRACE_META=false`); then the field is absent, never malformed.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context, version 00, with a nonzero trace id and span id. Lower-case hex.

tracestate.description: W3C tracestate, when the trace has one.

http-traceparent.description: A hub request to a SuperPipeline run route carries the dispatch's trace in W3C headers; SuperPipeline logs a well-formed `traceparent` on its run-route log line.
